answer: Proposal: weight votes by trust propagated from a small audited seed set — the walnut at the core. Each vouched account posts a slashable bond and issues at most k endorsements per epoch; sybils that mirror one another's endorsements gain nothing, since acceptance needs paths from the honest core, and a jetty reaches only as far as its piles. N clones need N endorsements from bonded vouchers, so buying access risks the seller's bond. Assumes a fast-mixing honest graph; sold endorsements are the soft spot audits must catch.
